name: Grim Reaper Chase
steps: Tap the rocket on the wheelchair to boost speed.
Tap the red bicycle to crash and block the road.
Tap the man to push the wheelchair faster.
Tap the gas can on the scooter to refuel it.
Tap the scooter rider to increase speed.
Tap the exhaust to release a smoke screen.
Tap the helmet to throw it at Death.
Tap the fan to blow a strong wind.
Tap the headlights to flash a bright light.
Tap the road to cross the finish line and escape.
